metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.background_rule: Black background may be a brand/style default, not a semantic system invariant.
semantics.text_rule: White text may be a brand/style default.
semantics.role_rule: Blue may serve primary presentation role and red as effect/accent where the active style declares it.
semantics.override_rule: Style Editor may override presentation values per site.
semantics.identity_rule: Color values/names are not semantic domain identities.
semantics.authority_rule: Brand palette has no runtime authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: silver/gold used as auth levels implicitly
